rule: FAILS if a classical attack matches or beats the hybrid in both channels at no greater flop cost

S1.name: field known only on a coarse time grid
S1.attack: cubic spline through the same samples + vps4
S1.note: already beats the hybrid on position at 121 nodes; GEMPIC closes this setting classically in the literature too

S2.name: deterministic quasi-periodic dB, 9 free parameters
S2.attack: least-squares identification of the tones + vps4
S2.note: the field is recovered to 7e-12; a deterministic field with finitely many parameters is always identifiable from data

S3.name: broadband dB, realization unknown, statistics public
attacks: Monte Carlo from the public PSD

numbers.coefficient_constant_to: 4 significant figures over two decades of amplitude (36.02 -> 36.09)

S3.note: the ensemble-averaged effect of a zero-mean broadband perturbation is exactly one number: the shift is quadratic in amplitude with a constant coefficient across the whole perturbative range. A classical attacker measures that number once with 48 antithetic runs (~5e6 flops at the working step, 9x less than a single hybrid run) and adds it. Nothing is left for an effective learned model except amortisation across queries, which is an engineering argument, not a numerical one.

S4.name: large step, field fully known
S4.attack: vps4 subcycled to the hybrid's own flop budget

known_competitor.what: learned generating function for large-step molecular dynamics; trained from scratch on autonomous systems
known_competitor.why_it_matters: direct precedent for a learned construction in exactly the large-step regime S4 probes. Not reimplemented (out of budget, and S4 is expected to die on flops regardless), but any wall-clock-only survival of S4 must be argued against this work, not only against filtered Boris.

S4.note: at matched flops the classical scheme is eleven orders of magnitude more accurate; wall-clock-only survival would also have to be argued against arXiv:2508.01068

S5.name: radiation reaction (Landau-Lifshitz)
S5.attack: the force is known in closed form
S5.note: dies on paper, as the plan anticipated: the LL force is an explicit function of the state and the known fields, so it enters the right-hand side directly and any classical scheme integrates it. There is no epistemic gap, only a stiffer ODE. The analytic contraction rate Lambda = 2(alpha - eps_rad) makes it a good VALIDATION system with an exact reference, which is how 08_ARCHITECTURE.md proposed using it -- but that is a test case, not a setting that needs learning.

summary.statement: No candidate setting survives classical attack. Every attack costs at most one hybrid run and wins on both channels, usually by orders of magnitude.
